control: max-turns (rich-triage.md: 25), compiled to claude --max-turns N in the agent step. Tested at 3 in .github/workflows/turns-test.md, as budget-test tests the credit caps at 1.
procedure: Owner adds the turns-test label to test issue #27. The prompt asks for 10 echo commands, one per turn, then noop. The credit cap (5) is far above what 3 turns cost, so only the turn cap can stop it.

expected.agent: Claude Code stops after 3 turns with a max-turns result (subtype error_max_turns or equivalent); fewer than 10 echo commands run
expected.noop: not called (the run ends before step 10)
expected.record: the number of echo commands that ran, the session result subtype and num_turns, and how gh-aw reports the run (job and run conclusion)

fail_if: any write to #27 or any other issue
